viewing_check: Estimate 30-50, current bid $20 (about $24.40 with 22% premium). About 20 bottles total. Single stoneware inks sell for A$20-33 and glass inks about A$7 each in lots, so the lot is worth roughly A$100-150 retail piece by piece if each sold alone, but that means 20 separate listings and postage on stoneware. Check the glass bottles for embossing (Stephens, Australian makers, Carter's, Davat) and the stoneware for maker stamps or labels (Doulton, Bourne, Thomas, Hood). Prices are 0-2 years old and flat. Some Terapeak rows had truncated dates (marked in the notes) and were not checked individually.
